Title: Keynote
Speaker: Scott Hanselman, Damian Edwards
Description: Software development has never stood still. From Windows to the web, from building across platforms to the cloud, every new era has opened up new possibilities. And through it all, .NET has evolved alongside you, helping you bring your code, your apps, and your ideas forward. Now, we're entering another defining moment. AI is changing not just what we build, but how we build it, opening up new ways to create, understand, modernize and operate applications. Join Scott Hanselman and the .NET team as we explore what's new in .NET 11, see how .NET is evolving for the applications you have and the ones you'll build next, and discover how Copilot and agents are shaping the next era of development. What's next isn't about starting over. It's about how far you can go from here.
DescriptionInZh: 软件开发从未停滞不前。从Windows到网页，从跨平台构建到云端，每一个新时代都开启了新的可能性。在这一切过程中，.NET与你一同演进，帮助你将代码、应用和想法推向前台。现在，我们正进入另一个关键时刻。人工智能不仅改变了我们构建的东西，也改变了构建方式，开启了创建、理解、现代化和运营应用的新途径。加入Scott Hanselman和.NET团队，一起探索.NET 11的新内容，看看.NET如何为你现有和未来构建的应用演进，并发现Copilot和代理如何塑造下一个开发时代。接下来的不是重新开始。而是你能走多远。

Title: What's new in C#
Speaker: Mads Torgersen, Dustin Campbell
Description: Union types are coming to C#! Unions model closed sets of data shapes, as commonly seen in e.g. wire protocols. Mads and Dustin explore the clean expression of intent and the confidence and elegance that unions lend to consuming code. We'll also take a look at other upcoming C# features, such as closed classes and extension indexers.
DescriptionInZh: 联合类型即将加入C#！联合体建模封闭数据集的数据形状，常见于线协议等。Mads和Dustin探讨了意图的清晰表达，以及合并为代码消费带来的信心和优雅。我们还将关注其他即将推出的C#功能，如闭类和扩展索引器。

Title: Modern web development with ASP.NET Core & Blazor in .NET 11
Speaker: Daniel Roth
Description: ASP.NET Core and Blazor in .NET 11 deliver improvements across the web stack, driven by developer feedback and the demands of large-scale production services. In this demo-packed tour, we’ll see how .NET 11 strengthens the platform fundamentals with advances in performance, security, and observability; increases productivity across Minimal APIs, SignalR, and Blazor; and makes it easier to build distributed and agentic web applications. We’ll explore highlights including asynchronous validation, richer API contracts, more capable server-side rendering, scalable Blazor apps, deeper Aspire integration, and new building blocks for agentic user interfaces. Whether you build APIs, interactive web applications, or AI-enabled experiences, you’ll leave knowing how .NET 11 helps you build faster, more reliable, and more ambitious web applications.
DescriptionInZh: ASP.NET Core 和 .NET 11 中的 Blazor 在整个网络栈中带来了改进，这些改进由开发者反馈和大规模生产服务的需求驱动。在这场充满演示的参观中，我们将看到 .NET 11 如何通过性能、安全和可观察性上的进步强化平台基础;提升 Minimal API、SignalR 和 Blazor 的生产力;并简化构建分布式和代理型网页应用。我们将探讨亮点，包括异步验证、更丰富的 API 合同、更强大的服务器端渲染、可扩展的 Blazor 应用、更深层次的 Aspire 集成以及代理用户界面的新构建模块。无论你构建的是 API、交互式网页应用，还是基于 AI 的体验，你都会带着 .NET 11 如何帮助你构建更快、更可靠、更具雄心的网络应用的知识离开。

Title: Moving `dotnet` Ahead (of Time)!
Speaker: Chet Husk
Description: In .NET 11, the `dotnet` CLI is a native app - it's snappy, responsive, and flexible! It took a lot of work to get there, and we learned about some 'gotchas' along the way, so we want to show you our process so that you can make excellent NAOT apps too!
DescriptionInZh: 在.NET 11中，“dotnet”CLI是原生应用——它响应迅速、灵活！我们花了很多功夫才达到这个阶段，也学到了不少“陷阱”，所以我们想向你展示我们的流程，让你也能做出优秀的NAOT应用！

Title: Why WinForms must not change - yet reinvented itself with .NET 11!
Speaker: Klaus Löffelmann
Description: Some of the world's most important line-of-business applications are built on WinForms. They contain decades of domain knowledge, countless customer-specific workflows, and—in many cases—millions of lines of proven code. Rewriting them is rarely economical, and breaking their behavioral or designer compatibility is simply not an option. That is why WinForms must not change. But standing still would be just as dangerous. To remain the best platform for evolving these applications, WinForms must also reinvent itself as the migration tool that lets teams modernize without discarding their investment. In .NET 11, that reinvention becomes visible. A new opt-in visual-styles generation gives controls modern metrics and appearance while preserving compatibility by default. Toggle switches, flash-reduced form startup, live Windows visual and accessibility settings, improved focus and text-scale handling, smoother batched UI updates, and new presentation capabilities help applications adopt today's Windows design language and accessibility expectations. The key is not to impose a disruptive new UI model, but to create deliberate conceptual seams inside existing applications: separating generated designer state from application logic, fixed layouts from adaptive layouts, synchronous UI mutation from responsive workflows, and irreplaceable business rules from replaceable presentation and infrastructure. AI makes those seams actionable at a scale that manual modernization could never reach. The designer and runtime must give AI-supported development enough structure to understand a form, preserve its intent, and transform it safely. At the same time, WinForms applications need modern runtime foundations through which developers can add domain-specific copilots, intelligent workflows, and local or connected AI services without rebuilding the entire product. This session explores how .NET 11 turns compatibility from a constraint into a modernization strategy—and how WinForms can preserve decades of customer value while helping business applications become more adaptive, accessible, performant, and ready for the AI era.
DescriptionInZh: 世界上一些最重要的业务线应用正是基于WinForms构建的。它们包含数十年的领域知识、无数客户专属工作流程，以及——在许多情况下——数百万行经过验证的代码。重写它们很少经济，破坏它们的行为兼容性或设计器兼容性根本不是选项。这就是为什么WinForms不能改变。但停滞不前同样危险。为了保持这些应用发展的最佳平台，WinForms也必须自我革新，成为让团队在不放弃投资的情况下实现现代化的迁移工具。在.NET 11中，这种重塑变得可见。新的可选加入视觉样式生成为控件提供了现代化的指标和外观，同时默认保持兼容性。切换开关、简化表单启动、实时Windows视觉和辅助设置、改进的焦点和文本比例处理、更流畅的批量UI更新以及新的展示功能，帮助应用程序采纳当今Windows设计语言和无障碍期望。关键不是强加颠覆性的全新UI模型，而是在现有应用中有意创造概念性接缝：将生成的设计器状态与应用逻辑分离，固定布局与自适应布局分离，同步UI变异与响应式工作流，以及不可替代的业务规则从可替代的展示和基础设施中分离。AI使这些接缝在手工现代化无法达到的规模上变得可操作。设计师和运行时必须为AI支持的开发提供足够的结构，使其能够理解表单、保持其意图并安全地进行转换。同时，WinForms应用需要现代化的运行时基础，使开发者能够添加领域特定的协同员、智能工作流以及本地或互联的AI服务，而无需重建整个产品。本节探讨了.NET 11如何将兼容性从限制转变为现代化策略——以及WinForms如何保持数十年的客户价值，同时帮助业务应用变得更加适应性强、可访问性、性能优异，并为AI时代做好准备。

Title: The .NET AI Stack: What's New, What's Next, and How It Fits Together
Speaker: Luis Quintanilla
Description: .NET developers have more AI building blocks than ever: model abstractions, data and retrieval, tools, agents, local inference, and the infrastructure that connects them. But how do these pieces fit together, and which ones should you reach for first? In this session, we'll take a practical look at the evolving .NET AI stack: what's available today, the patterns emerging across the ecosystem, and where things may be heading next. Through a combination of examples and demos, we'll explore how the pieces can be composed into useful applications. Whether you're just getting started or already building AI-powered software, you'll leave with a clearer mental model for navigating the .NET AI ecosystem and building what comes next.
DescriptionInZh: .NET 开发者拥有比以往更多的 AI 构建模块：模型抽象、数据与检索、工具、代理、本地推理以及连接它们的基础设施。但这些部分如何衔接？你应该优先考虑哪些？在本节课中，我们将实际探讨不断演变的 .NET AI 协议栈：现有的可用内容、生态系统中出现的模式以及未来可能的发展方向。通过示例和演示的结合，我们将探讨如何将这些部分组合成有用的应用。无论你是刚起步还是已经在构建 AI 驱动的软件，你都会带着更清晰的思维模型，帮助你导航 .NET AI 生态系统，构建未来。

Title: What's New in .NET MAUI in .NET 11
Speaker: Gerald Versluis
Description: .NET MAUI in .NET 11 continues to improve the experience of building production-quality mobile and desktop applications from a single codebase. In this session, we’ll explore the latest improvements, including the move to CoreCLR, XAML source generation enabled by default, C# expressions in XAML, XAML Incremental Hot Reload, and Material 3 styling on Android. We’ll also look at improvements to testing and the developer workflow, including how AI-assisted development fits into everyday .NET MAUI work. Join us for a practical tour of what’s new, what these changes mean for your existing applications, and how to take advantage of them in your next release.
DescriptionInZh: .NET 11中的.NET MAUI持续提升从单一代码库构建生产级移动和桌面应用的体验。在本环节中，我们将探讨最新改进，包括向CoreCLR的迁移、默认启用的XAML源代码生成、XAML中的C#表达式、XAML增量热加载以及Android上的Material 3样式。我们还将探讨测试和开发者工作流程的改进，包括AI辅助开发如何融入日常.NET MAUI工作。加入我们，进行一次实践之旅，了解新功能、这些变化对现有应用意味着什么，以及如何在下一个版本中利用这些变化。

Title: C# Dev Kit 11: Faster Foundations for .NET Development—and What Comes Next
Speaker: Drew Noakes, Emanuel Fernandez Dell'Oca
Description: C# Dev Kit brings a rich C# development experience to VS Code. In version 11, we rebuilt its foundations to make that experience significantly faster and lighter. In our benchmarks, large workspaces that previously took over a minute to load now open in only a few seconds, while a new incremental build system makes common builds substantially faster. In this session, you’ll see these improvements in action and learn the architectural decisions behind them: how five back-end processes became one Native AOT server, how the design of that server changed, and how persistent caches avoid repeatedly computing the same information. We’ll also look beyond VS Code at how these foundations could support .NET development across editors, command-line tools, and agent-driven workflows—and how your feedback can help shape what comes next.
DescriptionInZh: C# 开发工具包为 VS Code 带来了丰富的 C# 开发体验。在版本 11 中，我们重建了基础，使体验更快更轻松。在我们的基准测试中，之前加载超过一分钟的大型工作区现在只需几秒钟即可打开，而新的增量构建系统则显著加快了通用构建速度。在本节课中，你将看到这些改进的实际应用，并学习背后的架构决策：五个后端进程如何变成一个原生 AOT 服务器，该服务器的设计如何改变，以及持久缓存如何避免重复计算相同信息。我们还将超越 VS Code 的框架，探讨这些基础如何支持跨编辑器、命令行工具和代理驱动工作流的 .NET 开发——以及你的反馈如何帮助塑造下一步。

Title: More Processes, More Problems - how to speed up your builds with Multithreaded MSBuild
Speaker: Chet Husk
Description: Builds happen super frequently, so making this faster can have huge impact on your inner loops. Multithreaded builds can drastically speed up your workflow, and it's easy to try out! Learn how to try this new execution mode, what it means for your builds, and how to get future-proof your projects and tools to take advantage of it.
DescriptionInZh: 构建非常频繁，所以加快速度会极大影响你的内部循环。多线程构建能大幅加快你的工作流程，而且很容易尝试！了解如何尝试这种新的执行模式，它对你的构建意味着什么，以及如何让你的项目和工具具备未来适应性，充分利用它。

Title: What's New in Aspire for .NET Developers
Speaker: Maddy Montaquila, Damian Edwards
Description: Last year, we told you that Aspire was for every developer - not just .NET developers. We've seen amazing adoption across all different languages, but of course, we have a special place in our heart for .NET. As we added new languages to Aspire, we challenged some of our early .NET-centric assumptions, and discovered a few ways to improve the experience we originally shipped. We're bringing some of these learnings back to the Aspire + .NET workflow, some which you can use today, and some coming very soon! Join Maddy and Damian from the Aspire team to learn how Aspire is better than ever for .NET developers - even if we changed the name 😉
DescriptionInZh: 去年，我们告诉你们，Aspire 是为所有开发者准备的——不仅仅是 .NET 开发者。我们见证了各种语言的惊人采用率，但当然，我们对 .NET 有着特殊的感情。当我们为 Aspire 添加新语言时，我们挑战了一些早期的 .NET 中心假设，发现了一些改进最初发布体验的方法。我们将这些经验带回 Aspire + .NET 工作流程，有些您今天就能使用，有些即将推出！加入 Aspire 团队的 Maddy 和 Damian，了解 Aspire 对 .NET 开发者来说比以往任何时候都更好——即使我们改了名字 😉

Title: 2 Secure 2 Curmudgeonly
Speaker: Barry Dorrans
Description: By popular demand (well, one person online), Barry returns with a summary of .NET's security bugs for 2025-2026, including things you, as a developer should do to avoid falling into the same deep pits.
DescriptionInZh: 应广泛需求（网上只有一个人），Barry 带来了总结。NET 2025-2026 年的安全漏洞，包括作为开发者你应采取的措施，以避免陷入同样的深渊。

Title: Beyond Autocomplete: Getting the Most from GitHub Copilot for .NET
Speaker: Wendy Breiding
Description: GitHub Copilot has evolved far beyond code completion. In this practical session, discover the latest Copilot experiences for .NET developers and learn how to use them effectively across the development lifecycle—from understanding unfamiliar code and planning changes to implementing features, refactoring, and debugging issues. Through real-world .NET examples, we’ll explore techniques for providing better context, crafting effective instructions, working with agentic capabilities, and keeping AI-generated changes accurate and maintainable. You’ll leave with repeatable workflows that help you spend less time on routine work and more time solving the problems that matter.
DescriptionInZh: GitHub Copilot 已经远远超越了代码完成。在这场实践课程中，您将了解 .NET 开发者的最新 Copilot 体验，并学习如何在开发生命周期中有效使用它们——从理解陌生代码、规划变更，到实现功能、重构和调试问题。通过真实的 .NET 实例，我们将探索提供更好上下文、制定有效指令、运用代理能力以及保持 AI 生成变更准确且可维护的技术。您将拥有可重复的工作流程，帮助您减少日常工作的时间，更多时间解决重要问题。

Title: .NET 11 Numerics
Speaker: Tanner Gooding
Description: .NET 11 expands the numerics toolbox with IEEE 754 decimal floating-point types, `BFloat16`, generic complex numbers, and new generic random-number APIs. It also brings performance and correctness improvements to `System.Numerics.Tensors`. We'll explore how the new types fit into generic math, choose the right precision and range, and see how layout-aware tensor operations improve performance while handling shapes, overlapping memory, and special values consistently. Along the way, we'll cover rounding and practical parsing and formatting improvements. We'll finish with a brief "and more is coming" look at .NET 12 tensor work, clearly distinguishing what's in .NET 11 from what comes next.
DescriptionInZh: .NET 11 扩展了数值工具箱，加入了 IEEE 754 十进制浮点类型、“BFloat16”、通用复数和新的通用随机数 API。它还为“系统.数值.张量”带来了性能和正确性提升。我们将探讨这些新类型如何融入通用数学，选择合适的精度和范围，并观察布局感知张量运算如何在处理形状、重叠内存和特殊值时提升性能。过程中，我们将介绍四舍五入以及实用的解析和格式改进。最后，我们将简要介绍“未来还会有更多”的 .NET 12 张量工作，明确区分 .NET 11 中的内容与后续内容。

Title: How Aspire uses .NET to build an agent-first toolchain for any programming language
Speaker: Maddy Montaquila, Jose Perez Rodriguez
Description: .NET is the backbone of a toolchain built for the next generation of software development - Aspire. Join Jose, Aspire’s team lead, and Maddy, Aspire PM, to explore how the Aspire CLI, AppHost, Dashboard, and developer tooling come together to give agents a structured way to understand, run, debug, observe, and deploy distributed applications. We’ll look at how Aspire brings together .NET technologies like Blazor, Native AOT, code generation, and more, to extend the development experience beyond .NET to languages like TypeScript, Python, and even Java. The result is a toolchain where .NET provides the orchestration, developer experience, and runtime foundation while developers and agents can work across the languages they're comfortable with for their apps. Come see how Aspire is using .NET to build a toolchain where developers and agents can work together across any codebase!
DescriptionInZh: .NET 是为下一代软件开发——Aspire 构建的工具链的骨干。加入 Aspire 团队负责人 Jose 和 Aspire 项目经理 Maddy，一起探索 Aspire CLI、AppHost、Dashboard 和开发者工具如何结合，为代理提供结构化的方式来理解、运行、调试、观察和部署分布式应用。我们将探讨 Aspire 如何整合 .NET 技术，如 Blazor、Native AOT、代码生成等，将开发体验从 .NET 扩展到 TypeScript、Python 甚至 Java 等语言。最终成果是一个工具链，.NET 提供编排、开发者体验和运行时基础，而开发者和代理则可以在他们熟悉的应用语言间协作。来看看 Aspire 如何利用 .NET 构建一个工具链，让开发者和代理能够跨任何代码库协作！

Title: .NET Runtime vNext: Memory Safety and Runtime Async
Speaker: Richard Lander, Andy Gocke
Description: The .NET Runtime is the source of many performance and security improvements that make your apps better. Runtime Async and the updated memory safety model are among the biggest changes we've ever delivered. Runtime Async moves async orchestration and codegen from the Roslyn compiler to the RyuJIT JIT compiler, to enable better performance. Memory safety adds more strict compile-enforcement and improved auditability for unsafe code use. These changes will be critical for the next generation of apps that get written and deployed.
DescriptionInZh: .NET 运行时是许多性能和安全改进的源泉，使你的应用变得更好。运行时异步和更新后的内存安全模型是我们迄今为止带来的最大变革之一。运行时异步将异步编排和代码生成从Roslyn编译器迁移到RyuJIT JIT编译器，以提升性能。内存安全增加了更严格的编译强制和改进的可审计性，防止使用不安全代码。这些变化对下一代开发和部署的应用至关重要。

Title: Post-Quantum Cryptography with .NET 11
Speaker: Jeremy Barton
Description: .NET 11 brings an expansion of the post-quantum cryptography capabilities. We will take a look at how the features can be used today and how we're preparing for the future.
DescriptionInZh: .NET 11 带来了后量子密码学能力的扩展。我们将探讨这些功能今天的应用，以及我们如何为未来做准备。

Title: Bringing dotnet run, test, and watch to .NET MAUI
Speaker: Jonathan Peppers
Description: The .NET CLI is central to how developers build and test .NET applications, but mobile development has traditionally required separate tooling and IDE-specific workflows. In .NET 11, `dotnet run`, `dotnet test`, and `dotnet watch` work with .NET MAUI applications on devices, emulators, and simulators. This talk covers what it took to bring these commands to Android and iOS. We will look at how the CLI selects a device, installs and launches an app, runs tests, captures results, and updates a running application when code changes. We will also examine the challenges that make mobile different from desktop, including platform tooling, application packaging, device communication, and process lifetime. Along the way, we will use the commands with real .NET MAUI projects and discuss how they fit into local development, automated testing, and CI. Attendees will leave knowing how to build simpler, scriptable mobile workflows using the same CLI they already use elsewhere in .NET.
DescriptionInZh: .NET CLI 是开发者构建和测试 .NET 应用的核心，但移动开发传统上需要独立的工具和 IDE 专用工作流程。在 .NET 11 中，“dotnet run”、“dotnet test” 和 “dotnet watch” 与设备、模拟器和模拟器的 .NET MAUI 应用相匹配。本次演讲涵盖了将这些命令带入 Android 和 iOS 所经历的过程。我们将了解 CLI 如何选择设备、安装和启动应用、运行测试、捕获结果，以及在代码变更时更新正在运行的应用程序。我们还将探讨移动端与桌面端的挑战，包括平台工具、应用打包、设备通信和进程寿命。在此过程中，我们将在真实的 .NET MAUI 项目中使用这些命令，并讨论它们如何融入本地开发、自动化测试和 CI。与会者将带着如何利用他们在 .NET 其他地方已使用的相同 CLI 构建更简单、可脚本化的移动工作流的知识离开。

Title: Keynote
Speaker: Mads Kristensen
Description: A lot has changed in Visual Studio, and there’s much more on the way. Join us for a tour of the ideas, improvements, and new capabilities transforming how developers get things done. We’ll look at what’s possible today, explore how the developer experience is evolving, and peek around the corner at what’s coming next for Visual Studio.
DescriptionInZh: Visual Studio 发生了许多变化，未来还会有更多新内容。欢迎加入我们，一起参观那些改变开发者完成工作方式的创意、改进和新功能。我们将探讨当今的可能性，探讨开发者体验如何演变，并展望 Visual Studio 未来的发展。

Title: The State of AI in Visual Studio
Speaker: Rachel Kang
Description: Visual Studio brings new brains and more choice to AI-assisted development. Explore a new agent harness powered by the Copilot SDK, expanded access to models and providers, and greater control over configuration and how AI works for you. See how GitHub Copilot and other AI options bring more capable agents, greater choice, and the flexibility to shape AI around every stage of your .NET development workflow.
DescriptionInZh: Visual Studio 为 AI 辅助开发带来新智慧和更多选择。探索由 Copilot SDK 驱动的新代理工具，扩展对模型和服务提供者的访问，以及对配置和 AI 工作方式的更大控制。看看 GitHub Copilot 及其他 AI 选项如何带来更强大的代理、更多选择，以及围绕 .NET 开发流程每个阶段塑造 AI 的灵活性。

Title: What's new in Visual Studio
Speaker: Jason Chlus
Description: Visual Studio keeps getting better for the work you do every day. Join us for a demo-packed tour of the latest features, productivity improvements, and tips and tricks for .NET developers. We'll explore smarter code navigation, a more customizable editor, better build and testing experiences, and new ways to work with Markdown and web files. Along the way, see how improvements driven by developer feedback make Visual Studio a great place to read, understand, review, and write code. From big additions to small quality-of-life wins, discover what's new and what you'll want to try next.
DescriptionInZh: Visual Studio 因你每天的工作而不断提升。加入我们，体验最新功能、生产力提升以及 .NET 开发者的技巧和技巧的演示之旅。我们将探索更智能的代码导航、更可定制的编辑器、更好的构建和测试体验，以及使用 Markdown 和网页文件的新方法。在此过程中，看到由开发者反馈驱动的改进如何使 Visual Studio 成为阅读、理解、审查和编写代码的绝佳场所。从重大新增内容到小小的便利，发现新内容以及你接下来想尝试的内容。

Title: Get the most out of git in Visual Studio
Speaker: Sebastian Hernandez
Description: Explore how you can do your code generation, version control tasks, and Pull Request management all without having to leave the IDE with all of the new version control capabilities inside of Visual Studio.
DescriptionInZh: 探索如何在不保留Visual Studio中所有新版本控制功能的IDE的情况下，完成代码生成、版本控制任务和拉取请求管理。

Title: What’s New in Visual Studio Debugging and Diagnostics
Speaker: Harshada Hole
Description: Discover what’s new in Visual Studio debugging and profiling—from hands-free, AI-assisted debugging to seamlessly continuing your investigation in the IDE. Through practical demos, explore how the latest experiences help you uncover issues, understand performance, and confidently validate fixes.
DescriptionInZh: 了解Visual Studio调试和性能分析的新动态——从免提AI辅助调试到在IDE中无缝继续调查。通过实践演示，探索最新体验如何帮助您发现问题、理解性能并自信验证修复方法。

Title: Blazor Server in .NET 11: Fast, resilient, and scalable
Speaker: Daniel Roth
Description: Great web apps need to load quickly, remain responsive, preserve user state through interruptions, and scale efficiently as demand grows. Blazor in .NET 11 expands its flexible server rendering model, which combines static server-side rendering with Blazor Server interactivity using the same component model. Static SSR now supports more application scenarios, including client-side validation, temporary data, session state, and output caching, allowing more experiences to run without an interactive circuit. Where rich interactivity is needed, persistent component state and circuit pause and resume make Blazor Server more resilient and scalable by avoiding duplicate work, preserving sessions across disconnections, freeing resources for inactive users, and supporting graceful deployments. See how these capabilities work together to help you build responsive, resilient web experiences that scale efficiently to support more users.
DescriptionInZh: 优秀的网页应用需要快速加载、保持响应性、在中断时保持用户状态，并随着需求增长高效扩展。Blazor在.NET 11中扩展了其灵活的服务器渲染模型，结合了静态服务器端渲染和使用相同组件模型的Blazor服务器交互性。静态SSR现在支持更多应用场景，包括客户端验证、临时数据、会话状态和输出缓存，使更多体验无需交互电路即可运行。在需要丰富交互性时，持久组件状态和电路暂停与恢复使Blazor服务器更具韧性和可扩展性，避免重复工作，断线时保持会话，释放资源给非活跃用户，并支持优雅部署。看看这些能力如何协同工作，帮助你构建响应迅速、韧性的网页体验，高效扩展以支持更多用户。

Title: What's new in the MCP C# SDK
Speaker: Stephen Halter
Description: The Model Context Protocol is evolving, and the MCP C# SDK is evolving with it. In this session, we’ll explore what’s new in the SDK and the latest protocol revision, from building scalable servers with stateless requests to collecting user input across multiple interactions. See these features in action in a practical C# server, and learn how the SDK continues to support existing MCP clients as the protocol evolves.
DescriptionInZh: 模型上下文协议正在演进，MCP C# SDK 也在随之演进。在本节中，我们将探讨SDK和最新协议修订版的新内容，从构建无状态请求的可扩展服务器到通过多重交互收集用户输入。在实际的C#服务器上看到这些功能，并了解SDK如何随着协议演进持续支持现有MCP客户端。

Title: Building great Windows apps with WinUI and agents
Speaker: Morten Nielsen, Niels Laute
Description: Discover how WinUI and the latest .NET tooling make it easier than ever to build modern, high-performance Windows apps. See how new `dotnet new` templates simplify project creation, how `dotnet run` seamlessly handles package identity, and how capabilities like Native AOT help developers deliver fast, efficient apps. We'll explore how modern tooling makes it easier to build, run, debug, test, and package WinUI apps using your favorite development environment, including Visual Studio and VS Code. You'll also see how WinAppCLI and AI coding agents come together to streamline development workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and help developers build great Windows apps faster.
DescriptionInZh: 了解 WinUI 和最新的 .NET 工具如何让构建现代高性能 Windows 应用变得前所未有的简单。了解新的“dotnet new”模板如何简化项目创建，“dotnet run” 如何无缝处理包身份，以及像 Native AOT 这样的功能如何帮助开发者交付快速高效的应用。我们将探讨现代工具如何让你更容易地在你喜欢的开发环境（包括 Visual Studio 和 VS Code）上构建、运行、调试、测试和打包 WinUI 应用。你还将看到 WinAppCLI 和 AI 编码代理如何协作，简化开发工作流程，自动化重复性任务，帮助开发者更快构建优秀的 Windows 应用。

Title: Building the future of agentic UI with Blazor
Speaker: Daniel Roth
Description: As AI agents move from answering questions to reasoning over context, using tools, and taking action, the needs of modern web UI are changing. Free-form chat remains a powerful and flexible foundation, but agentic applications must also communicate progress and tool activity, connect conversations to structured interfaces, synchronize shared state, request human decisions, and keep users in control. In this session, we’ll explore the emerging patterns shaping agentic UI and how .NET and the Microsoft stack support them. Through live demonstrations, see how the experimental Blazor AI components, the open AG-UI protocol, Microsoft Agent Framework, Microsoft Foundry, and Aspire work together to enable streaming interactions, custom tool experiences, human-in-the-loop workflows, and shared application state. Learn how these pieces fit together and what they mean for the next generation of web development with Blazor.
DescriptionInZh: 随着AI代理从回答问题转向基于上下文推理、使用工具和采取行动，现代Web UI的需求正在发生变化。自由形式聊天依然是强大且灵活的基础，但代理应用还必须传达进展和工具活动，将对话连接到结构化界面，同步共享状态，请求人类决策，并保持用户控制。在本节中，我们将探讨塑造代理UI的新趋势，以及.NET和Microsoft协议栈如何支持这些模式。通过现场演示，您可以了解实验性的Blazor AI组件、开放的AG-UI协议、Microsoft代理框架、Microsoft Foundry和Aspire如何协同工作，实现流式交互、定制工具体验、人机协作流程和共享应用状态。了解这些元素如何相互配合，以及它们对Blazor下一代网页开发的意义。

Title: CsWinRT 3.0: Modernizing the Windows Projections for .NET
Speaker: Manodasan Wignarajah, Sergio Pedri
Description: Learn what’s coming in CsWinRT 3.0, a major redesign of our WinRT projection support for .NET based on developer feedback.
DescriptionInZh: 了解 CsWinRT 3.0 中即将推出的内容，这是基于开发者反馈对 .NET WinRT 投影支持的重大重设计。

Title: GitHub Copilot modernization
Speaker: Mika Dumont
Description: This session covers how agentic modernization can accelerate a .NET upgrade. We'll walk through a real migration end to end, from assessing what will break before you start, through the upgrade itself, to getting a change your team will actually merge. Along the way we'll look at where the agent does the work for you, where it hands back to you, and how to extend it with your own skills when your codebase doesn't match the default path.
DescriptionInZh: 本节将介绍代理现代化如何加速 .NET 升级。我们将带你从端到端地了解真实的迁移过程，从评估开始前哪些地方会出问题，到升级本身，再到实现团队实际合并的变更。在这个过程中，我们会了解代理在哪些方面为你完成工作，哪些地方交还给你，以及当你的代码库与默认路径不匹配时，如何用自己的技能扩展代理。

Title: Beyond Code Generation: Give AI Eyes and Hands for .NET MAUI
Speaker: Gerald Versluis
Description: AI can generate your XAML and C#, but can it tell whether the button is actually visible or the screen behaves as intended? Building mobile and desktop apps takes more than code generation. Your AI assistant needs eyes and hands on the running app. In this demo-driven session, we'll explore how DevFlow and an interactive mobile canvas connect GitHub Copilot to a running .NET MAUI app. Starting with an existing application, we'll inspect the UI, give the assistant context about specific controls, interact with the app, and use logs and runtime information to investigate problems. We'll then make targeted code changes and replay user workflows to check the results. Along the way, we'll see where MCP fits, what these experimental tools can and cannot do, and where developer judgment still matters. You'll leave with practical patterns for moving beyond generated code to an AI-assisted feedback loop for your own .NET MAUI apps.
DescriptionInZh: AI可以生成你的XAML和C#，但它能否判断按钮是否真实可见，或者屏幕是否按预期表现？构建移动和桌面应用不仅仅是代码生成。你的AI助手需要亲眼观察运行中的应用。在这场演示驱动的环节中，我们将探讨DevFlow和交互式移动画布如何将GitHub Copilot连接到运行中的.NET MAUI应用。从现有应用开始，我们会检查UI，向助手提供具体控制的背景信息，与应用交互，并利用日志和运行时信息调查问题。然后我们会针对性地修改代码，并重放用户工作流程以核查结果。在此过程中，我们将看到MCP的定位，这些实验性工具能做什么不能做什么，以及开发者的判断仍然重要。你将带着实用的经验，帮助你从生成代码转向AI辅助反馈循环，应用于你自己的.NET MAUI应用。

Title: No XAML Required: Native Windows Apps in Pure C#
Speaker: Alexandre Zollinger Chohfi
Description: What if a complete native Windows app were a single C# file - no .csproj, no App.xaml, no code-behind, no ViewModels? Microsoft.UI.Reactor is an experimental C# framework that brings the MVU (Model-View-Update) pattern to WinUI 3. Your UI is a function of your state. State lives in hooks, next to the code that uses it. And every control on screen is a real WinUI control - the same runtime, the same controls, the same theming as the XAML app next door. We'll start by running a complete Windows app with dotnet run app.cs, then build up: hooks and state, lists and keyed reconciliation, and the 60+ Roslyn analyzers that catch UI bugs while you type - because when your UI is ordinary C#, the entire .NET toolchain points straight at it. This is an experiment, and the talk is honest about that: what works, what's rough, what we got wrong, and where XAML and MVVM fit alongside it (spoiler: they aren't going anywhere). Come for the live demo, leave with an opinion - we're actively collecting them.
DescriptionInZh: 如果一个完整的原生Windows应用是一个单一的C#文件——没有.csproj，没有App.xaml，没有代码背后，没有ViewModels，会怎样？Microsoft.UI.Reactor是一个实验性的C#框架，将MVU（模型-视图-更新）模式引入WinUI 3。你的UI是你的状态函数。状态存在于钩子中，紧邻使用它的代码。屏幕上的每个控件都是真正的WinUI控件——与隔壁的XAML应用相同运行时、相同的控件、相同的主题。我们将先运行一个完整的Windows应用，运行dotnet app.cs，然后逐步构建：钩子和状态、列表和键密钥对账，以及60+ Roslyn分析器，在你输入时能捕捉UI的错误——因为当你的UI是普通C#时，整个.NET工具链都指向它。这是一个实验，演讲内容坦诚：什么有效，哪些粗糙，我们做错了什么，XAML和MVVM在其中扮演什么角色（剧透：它们不会消失）。欢迎来现场演示，带着看法离开——我们正在积极收集这些意见。

Title: Azure's new lineup for .NET developers (Part 1)
Speaker: Matt Soucoup, Paul Yuknewicz
Description: Meet some of Azure's newest cast members for .NET developers. A Container Apps sandbox handles the code you'd rather keep at arm's length. AI Gateway keeps tabs on every model and tool your app calls, SRE Agent is the one who answers the pager at 2 AM, and Copilot canvases put Azure right in your developer workflow.. And... we're having them do all their own stunts, live on stream.
DescriptionInZh: 认识一下Azure最新的.NET开发团队成员。容器应用沙盒处理你想保持距离的代码。AI网关会监控你应用调用的每个模型和工具，SRE代理负责凌晨2点的呼叫器，Copilot canvases则将Azure直接带入你的开发者工作流程。而且......我们让他们自己做所有的特技，直播直播。

Title: Azure's new lineup for .NET developers (Part 2)
Speaker: Matt Soucoup, Paul Yuknewicz
Description: Meet some of Azure's newest cast members for .NET developers. A Container Apps sandbox handles the code you'd rather keep at arm's length. Copilot canvases put Azure right in your editor. AI Gateway keeps tabs on every model and tool your app calls, and SRE Agent is the one who answers the pager at 2 AM. And... we're having them do all their own stunts, live on stream.
DescriptionInZh: 认识一下Azure最新的.NET开发团队成员。容器应用沙盒处理你想保持距离的代码。Copilot画布将Azure直接放进你的编辑器。AI网关跟踪你应用调用的每个模型和工具，SRE代理负责凌晨2点接听寻呼机。而且......我们让他们自己做所有特技，直播直播。

Title: C# File-based apps turned up to 11!
Speaker: Damian Edwards
Description: C# file-based apps are getting a serious upgrade in .NET 11. In this session, we’ll tour the latest improvements, including faster launch performance, app-to-app references, richer package reference support, and expanded CLI support across more `dotnet` commands. We’ll see how file-based apps are growing from a lightweight way to run a single C# file into a surprisingly capable model for building real tools and applications—without giving up the simplicity that made them compelling in the first place. If you’ve been curious how far C# can go without a project file, .NET 11 turns it up to 11!
DescriptionInZh: 基于文件的应用在.NET 11中正经历重大升级。在本场会议中，我们将介绍最新的改进，包括更快的启动性能、应用间引用、更丰富的包引用支持，以及扩展到更多“dotnet”命令的CLI支持。我们将看到基于文件的应用如何从轻量级运行单个C#文件，成长为一个令人惊喜的强大模型，用于构建真实工具和应用——同时不放弃它们最初吸引人的简单性。如果你好奇C#在没有项目文件的情况下能走多远，.NET 11将它提升到极致！

Title: .NET + Foundry: Better Together
Speaker: Bruno Capuano
Description: Microsoft Foundry keeps raising the bar for AI. What does that mean for your next C# app? Join this session for a demo-packed tour of the latest Foundry features and services, and discover how to get the most out of them with .NET. From powerful models to new AI capabilities, we’ll explore what’s new, what matters, and what’s worth bringing into your projects. Less slideware, more possibilities, and plenty of “I could use that!” moments.
DescriptionInZh: Microsoft Foundry 不断提升 AI 的标准。这对你的下一个 C# 应用意味着什么？加入本次环节，参加充满演示的 Foundry 最新功能和服务之旅，发现如何用 .NET 最大化利用它们。从强大的模型到新的 AI 能力，我们将探讨什么是新颖、重要以及值得带入项目的要素。少一些幻灯片，更多可能性，还有许多“我真需要这个！”的瞬间。

Title: EF Core 11: Vector Search, Smarter LINQ, and a Friendlier dotnet ef
Speaker: Jiri Cincura
Description: EF Core 11 touches every layer of the stack. In this session we’ll tour the highlights: approximate vector search and full-text search on SQL Server, new LINQ operators like FullJoin and MaxBy/MinBy, and a query pipeline that produces noticeably leaner SQL. We’ll cover modeling upgrades for complex types and JSON, a far less ceremonious dotnet ef (config files, file-based apps, one-step migrations), bulk and batch support for Cosmos DB, and what to watch for when you upgrade.
DescriptionInZh: EF Core 11 涵盖了协议栈的每一层。本场我们将介绍亮点：SQL Server 上的近似矢量搜索和全文搜索，新的 LINQ 运算符如 FullJoin 和 MaxBy/MinBy，以及一个能产出明显更精简 SQL 的查询流水线。我们将涵盖复杂类型和 JSON 的建模升级、更轻松的 dotnet ef（配置文件、基于文件的应用、一步迁移）、Cosmos DB 的批量和批处理支持，以及升级时需要注意的事项。

Title: Beyond the Agent Trace: Operating Foundry Agents with Aspire
Speaker: Shweta Iyer
Description:
Building an agent is only the beginning. When a request produces a slow, incorrect, or incomplete result, developers need visibility into both the agent’s execution and the application surrounding it.

In this session, I’ll share practical patterns from a procurement workflow built in C# that calls a Microsoft Foundry agent, using Aspire for application observability and transactional business audit records. We’ll compare agent-centric traces in Foundry with application-centric traces in Aspire, following a sourcing request through an API, supplier lookup, agent invocation, output validation, and persistence.

Then we’ll break the workflow: the agent succeeds, but the business transaction fails. Through this example, we’ll explore trace correlation, business-stage instrumentation, dependency deadlines and retries, sensitive-data boundaries, and why telemetry and business auditing answer different questions.
DescriptionInZh:
构建代理只是开始。当请求产生缓慢、错误或不完整的结果时，开发者需要对代理的执行及其周边应用的可视化。

在本节会议中，我将分享一个基于C#构建的采购工作流程中的实用模式，该流程调用Microsoft Foundry代理，使用Aspire进行应用可观察性和事务性业务审计记录。我们将比较Foundry中以代理为中心的追踪与Aspire中以应用为中心的跟踪，依据API的源源请求、供应商查询、代理调用、输出验证和持久化。

然后我们会打破工作流程：代理成功，但业务交易失败。通过这个例子，我们将探讨追踪相关性、业务阶段的仪器、依赖截止日期和重试、敏感数据边界，以及为何遥测和业务审计回答不同问题。

Title: AI Journey with Telerik UI for Blazor: From Developer Productivity to Intelligent User Experiences
Speaker: Maya Mateva
Description: AI is transforming both how applications are built and how users interact with them. In this session, we'll explore the complete AI journey with Blazor, starting with Telerik MCP, AI skills, and intelligent tooling that accelerate development, simplify upgrades, and help developers stay productive throughout the application lifecycle. We'll then demonstrate how modern Blazor applications can deliver intelligent user experiences using AI-enabled UI components, WebMCP, Microsoft Agent Framework, AG-UI, and A2UI. You'll see how you can enable agent-ready applications where AI can assist developers during implementation and seamlessly collaborate with users through rich, dynamic, and adaptive interfaces.
DescriptionInZh: 人工智能正在改变应用的构建方式以及用户与应用的互动方式。在本场会议中，我们将探讨Blazor的完整AI旅程，从Telerik MCP、AI技能和智能工具开始，这些工具加速开发、简化升级，并帮助开发者在整个应用生命周期中保持高效。接着，我们将展示现代Blazor应用如何通过AI驱动的UI组件、WebMCP、Microsoft代理框架、AG-UI和A2UI实现智能用户体验。你将看到如何启用代理就绪应用，AI在实现过程中协助开发者，并通过丰富、动态且自适应的界面与用户无缝协作。

Title: Miniservices not Microservices in Azure
Speaker: Shawn Wildermuth
Description: For small and medium sized businesses, the complexity of setting up and maintaining Kubernetes cluster or even Container Services (ACS) is not necessary. In this talk, I'll introduce a middle ground of using Azure's databases, AppServices, Azure Functions and ServiceBus to build out simplified architecture without resorting to full-blown microservices.
DescriptionInZh: 对于中小企业来说，搭建和维护Kubernetes集群甚至容器服务（ACS）的复杂性并非必要。在本次演讲中，我将介绍一个中间方案：利用Azure的数据库、AppServices、Azure Functions和ServiceBus来构建简化架构，而无需依赖完整的微服务。

Title: Build a .NET TUI in 30 Minutes
Speaker: Isaac Levin
Description:
Command-line tools are quick to create, but they often become difficult to use once a workflow requires multiple inputs, validation, progress updates, and meaningful results. A terminal UI provides structure and guidance without the deployment, hosting, and maintenance overhead of a web application—making it a practical fit for developer tools, internal utilities, deployment helpers, and AI-assisted workflows.

In this live build, we’ll turn a basic .NET console app into a maintainable TUI. You’ll learn how to:

- Guide users with prompts, selections, and validation
- Display tables, panels, and progress feedback
- Separate presentation from application logic
- Test workflows without fragile terminal automation
- Use Aspire integration for observability and diagnostics

You’ll leave with a reusable structure for building tools that are easier to operate, safer than ad hoc scripts, and simpler to support when something goes wrong.
DescriptionInZh:
命令行工具创建迅速，但一旦工作流程需要多输入、验证、进度更新和有意义的结果，使用起来往往变得困难。终端界面提供了结构和指导，而无需承担网页应用的部署、托管和维护负担——使其非常适合开发者工具、内部工具、部署助手和AI辅助工作流。

在这个正式版本中，我们将把一个基础的.NET控制台应用变成一个可维护的TUI。你将学会如何：

- 通过提示、选择和验证引导用户
- 显示表格、面板及进度反馈
- 将呈现与应用逻辑分离
- 测试工作流程，无需脆弱终端自动化
- 使用 Aspire 集成进行可观察性和诊断

你会得到一个可重复使用的结构，构建更易操作、比临时脚本更安全、且在出现问题时更易支持的工具。

Title: Lessons from Blazor WASM in Production
Speaker: James Hutchison
Description:
How does Blazor WASM work in production? We think pretty well, but not without issue. This talk is based on our experiences of converting a large, complex UI (180+ components) from ASP.net Webforms to Blazor. This talk covers:
- Does Blazor WASM live up to its original hype? Yes, but not quite how we envisaged.
- Our migration strategy from Webforms to Blazor WASM.
- Authentication and general architectural design.
- General issues, performance pitfalls and their solutions.
Hop on and get enthused about Blazor WASM.
DescriptionInZh:
Blazor WASM 在生产环境中是如何工作的？我们思维能力不错，但并非没有问题。本次演讲基于我们将大型复杂界面（180+ 组件）从 ASP.net Webforms 转换为 Blazor 的经验。本次演讲涵盖：
- Blazor WASM 是否符合最初的宣传？是的，但不完全符合我们预期的水平。
- 我们从Webforms迁移到Blazor WASM。
- 认证与一般架构设计。
- 一般性问题、性能陷阱及其解决方案。
快上网，热情支持Blazor WASM。

Title: Building a multi agent solution using Aspire
Speaker: Juergen Gutsch
Description:
In my spare time, I vibe-coded (actually, wise-coded) an application that runs multiple AI agents, controlled by a planning AI agent, to perform penetration tests on web applications.
It uses tools like Playwright and Aspire to optimize agentic development.
It's built with .NET and React, but uses alternative components to build and run the spare-time project faster and cheaper.
This session gives you an overview of how I built it and what it needs to run multiple agents for penetration testing.
DescriptionInZh:
业余时间，我用vibe代码（实际上是wise-code）写了一个运行多个AI代理、由规划AI代理控制的应用，用来对网页应用进行渗透测试。

Title: Killing Session Theft: Device Bound Session Credentials using ASP.NET Core
Speaker: Wesley Cabus
Description:
Infostealer malware doesn't need your password if it can steal your authentication cookie from disk or memory, and replay it on another machine. Any webserver happily accepts the stolen cookie since it was issued by the webserver itself. This type of attack bypasses WebAuthn or MFA entirely, since the cookie gets stolen after you have authenticated. Since there's no real fix against this, we can only issue cookies with a shorter lifetime to minimize the attack window.

Until now. Device Bound Session Credentials (DBSC) is a W3C draft introducing a solution, by tying the session cookie to the browser or device. The browser generates a private/public key pair, storing the private key ideally in secure storage like a TPM, while the webserver only issues short-lived authentication cookies. When the cookie expires, the browser can then only refresh the cookie by signing a server-issued challenge using that private device-specific key. While this doesn't prevent cookie and session theft, it does minimize the risk since cookies go stale faster and cannot be renewed without the device's private key.

During this session, I'll demonstrate how DBSC works by showing an example implementation in ASP.NET Core, adding the necessary endpoints to safely register and refresh DBSC-enabled session cookies.
DescriptionInZh:
如果信息窃取者恶意软件能从磁盘或内存中窃取你的认证Cookie，并在另一台机器上重放，它就不需要你的密码。任何网页服务器都乐意接受被盗的cookie，因为它是由网页服务器自己发布的。这种攻击完全绕过WebAuthn或MFA，因为Cookie是在你认证后才被盗的。由于没有真正的解决办法，我们只能发布寿命较短的Cookie以减少攻击窗口。

直到现在。设备绑定会话凭证（DBSC）是W3C的一个草案，提出了解决方案，通过将会话Cookie绑定到浏览器或设备。浏览器生成私钥/公钥对，理想情况下将私钥存储在安全存储中，如TPM，而网页服务器仅发送短暂的认证Cookie。当Cookie过期时，浏览器只能通过使用该专用设备密钥签署服务器发布的挑战来刷新Cookie。虽然这不能防止Cookie和会话被盗，但可以降低风险，因为Cookie会更快过时，且没有设备私钥无法续订。

在本节课中，我将演示DBSC的工作原理，展示 ASP.NET Core中的示例实现，添加安全注册和刷新启用DBSC的会话Cookie所需的端点。

Speaker: André Silva
Description:
Imagine unleashing new features into the wild without the fear of breaking things... Enter the world of feature flags. Picture this: your team ships code to production seamlessly, yet the power to unveil new functionalities remains entirely in your hands. This dynamic decoupling lets you test features live, roll them out gradually, and gather real-world feedback, all while mitigating risks and accelerating confident releases.

In the realm of applications, feature flag libraries weave effortlessly into your codebase, championing agile strategies like trunk-based development and dark launches. But why stop there? Step into the future with OpenFeature, an open-source, vendor-neutral standard that unifies feature flag management. With it, you wave goodbye to vendor lock-in and welcome streamlined experimentation across diverse environments.

Harnessing OpenFeature and vendor-neutral feature flags unlocks:

• Lightning-fast, risk-free deployments with hidden features until the perfect moment
• Precision targeting for canary releases, A/B tests, and tailored user experiences
• A harmonised, standardised approach to flag management across your tech ecosystem

Embrace this cutting-edge methodology to revolutionise your release process: achieve agility without sacrificing stability, and turn every deployment into an opportunity to innovate with confidence.

For this demo, I will be using Aspire with the flagd integration to showcase the potential of these two technologies together.
DescriptionInZh:
想象一下，在没有破坏游戏的恐惧下，将新功能推向现实......进入功能标志的世界。想象一下：你的团队无缝地将代码交付生产环境，但新功能的发布权完全掌握在你手中。这种动态解耦让你能够实时测试功能，逐步推出，收集真实反馈，同时降低风险，加快自信发布。

在应用领域，特征标志库轻松融入你的代码库，倡导如基于trunk的开发和暗发布等敏捷策略。但为什么止步于此？迈向未来，OpenFeature是一个开源、供应商中立的标准，统一了功能标志管理。有了它，你告别了厂商锁定，欢迎在多样环境中进行简化的实验。

利用OpenFeature和供应商中立的功能标志可解锁：

• 极快、无风险的部署，隐藏功能，直到完美时刻
• 金丝雀发布、A/B测试及定制用户体验的精准定位
• 在技术生态系统中实现统一、标准化的旗帜管理方法

拥抱这一前沿方法，彻底革新您的发布流程：实现敏捷而不牺牲稳定性，将每一次部署都转化为自信创新的机会。

在本次演示中，我将使用带有标记集成的Aspire，展示这两种技术的共同潜力。

Title: The Most Overengineered Pocketwatch Ever Made
Speaker: Ed Charbeneau
Description:
This session is a retrospective on the engineering behind a pocket watch that runs a real-time voice agent. Built end to end in a single week with Claude Code, from product idea to working reality complete with its own product page, this project showcases an entirely agentic workflow for rapid prototyping and iterative development.

We'll explore the ESP32-S3 audio pipeline, including capture, echo cancellation, and the barge-in system that lets users interrupt mid-sentence, then follow the audio into Deepgram's Voice Agent API, where speech-to-text, LLM reasoning, and text-to-speech run as a single unified agent. 

The device becomes actionable when we target it at Azure OpenAI, or at your own ASP.NET Core endpoint hosted in Azure, so the agent's reasoning, function calling, and business logic live in the .NET stack you already know while the device stays lightweight.

我们将探讨ESP32-S3音频流程，包括捕获、回声消除，以及允许用户在句子中途中断，然后将音频输入Deepgram的Voice Agent API，在这里语音转文字、LLM推理和文本转语音作为一个统一的代理运行。 

当我们针对Azure OpenAI或你自己托管在Azure中的 ASP.NET Core端点时，设备变得可操作，这样代理的推理、函数调用和业务逻辑都存在于你已知的.NET栈中，而设备则保持轻量级。

Title: Clean Architecture AND MORE with ASP.NET Core
Speaker: Ardalis .
Description:
It's 2026 and Clean Architecture is still a relevant topic for software developers looking to write less tightly-coupled code. By understanding and applying a few principles, you can ensure your application remains loosely-coupled to infrastructure concerns. You'll see how in this session.

You'll ALSO see how to leverage the benefits of Vertical Slices in your architecture, which make it easier to ship new features and helps organize those features cohesively in your application.

Finally, you'll see how even with these two approaches, many applications can turn into a Big Ball of Mud because they lack modularity. You'll learn how using encapsulated module architecture can avoid this common architectural pitfall.

Title: How Do AI Systems Like ChatGPT Work? A Clear Explanation for Everyone!
Speaker: Otto Dobretsberger
Description: This session offers an accessible exploration of the inner workings of AI systems like ChatGPT, demystifying how these advanced language models generate human-like responses. We will break down the process of how large language models (LLMs) construct answers token by token, illustrating the step-by-step mechanics of language generation. Attendees will learn about the key components that drive these systems, including the role of training data, neural network architectures, and the probabilistic nature of response generation. We will also discuss how external factors, such as input prompts and fine-tuning, influence the model’s outputs, and explore the dependencies that shape their performance. Designed for a general audience, this talk avoids technical jargon while providing a clear, engaging look at the fascinating technology behind AI language systems, offering insights into their capabilities and limitations.
DescriptionInZh: 本场次将深入探讨ChatGPT等AI系统的内部运作，揭开这些先进语言模型如何生成类人响应的神秘面纱。我们将解析大型语言模型（LLMs）如何逐令牌构建答案的过程，展示语言生成的逐步机制。参与者将了解驱动这些系统的关键组成部分，包括训练数据的作用、神经网络架构以及反应生成的概率性。我们还将讨论输入提示和微调等外部因素如何影响模型输出，并探讨塑造其表现的依赖关系。本次演讲面向大众，避免使用技术术语，清晰且引人入胜地介绍AI语言系统背后引人入胜的技术，深入解析其能力与局限性。

Speaker: Jeffrey Palermo
Description: While it is useful and necessary to learn and use AI tools, .NET developers need to be able to integrate AI into existing software applications. This session will focus on the architecture implications of AI, where large language models fit into existing .NET applications, and how to integrate them into DevOps environments , including source control, builds, testing, and deployment- all powered by GitHub Copilot and Azure.
DescriptionInZh: 虽然学习和使用AI工具非常有用且必要，但.NET开发者需要能够将AI集成到现有软件应用中。本节将重点探讨AI的架构影响、大型语言模型在现有.NET应用中的作用，以及如何将它们集成到DevOps环境中，包括源代码控制、构建、测试和部署——所有这些都由GitHub Copilot和Azure驱动。

Just because Godot targets .NET 8 doesn't mean you can't use these features! We'll use PolySharp to easily access any of the latest syntactic sugar you want to use.

Find out how these new C# features can help you with your Godot game.

想在 Godot 中使用最新的 C# 功能，比如 Unions 和 Indexer 扩展吗？来了解一下怎么做吧！

了解这些新的 C# 功能如何帮助你完成 Godot 游戏。

Title: What NOT to AI: Hand-Crafting Your App’s Core Foundation
Speaker: Michael Washington
Description: While AI tools and workflows like "Vibe Coding" can rapidly generate applications, they often fall short when it comes to the core architecture of your software. In the Agentic Coding workflow, developers must transition from being typists to acting as strict architects. This session covers the critical code and infrastructure decisions you must handle manually and should never leave up to the AI. Learn how to define your application's foundation, including your database design, authentication mechanisms (like JWT vs. cookies), and Data Context structure. Finally, discover the importance of using dedicated tools—such as EF Core Power Tools—to update your data context reliably, ensuring your AI agents have a solid, well-defined blueprint to build upon.
DescriptionInZh: 虽然像“Vibe Coding”这样的AI工具和工作流程可以快速生成应用，但在软件核心架构方面往往表现不足。在代理编码工作流程中，开发者必须从打字员转变为严格的架构师。本课程涵盖了你必须手动处理的关键代码和基础设施决策，绝不应交由AI自行处理。学习如何定义应用的基础，包括数据库设计、认证机制（如JWT与cookies）以及数据上下文结构。最后，发现使用专用工具（如EF Core Power Tools）的重要性，以可靠更新数据上下文，确保你的AI代理拥有坚实且明确的蓝图可供构建。

Speaker: Paul Usher
Description:
Building a .NET MAUI application is easy.

Building one that survives workshops, warehouses, field technicians, unreliable connectivity, large datasets, cameras, signatures, PDFs and users who absolutely will press that button twice is another matter entirely.

In this session, we'll look at lessons learned from building and deploying real-world .NET MAUI business applications across iOS and Android.

We'll explore practical patterns for responsive mobile UI, local data, offline workflows, asynchronous operations, device capabilities and interfaces that need to work equally well on phones and tablets.

We'll also look at what .NET 11 brings to the MAUI landscape, including the move to CoreCLR, and where that may change the way we think about performance and application architecture.

The examples come from production applications used in workshops and field-service environments, where network connectivity, hardware differences and unpredictable user behaviour are part of the specification whether we like it or not.

No Todo apps. No perfect Wi-Fi. Just production software and the lessons learned when it meets the real world.

Speaker: Shriram Sankaran
Description:

In this session, I will demonstrate how Razor components, services, UI patterns, and business logic can be shared between a Blazor web application and a .NET MAUI Blazor Hybrid app targeting Android, iOS, Windows, and macOS.

The live demonstration will show the same application running on the web and as a native hybrid application, with shared components such as data grids and charts. I will explain what can be reused directly, what requires platform-specific adaptation, and how to structure shared code using Razor Class Libraries and BlazorWebView.

The session will also explore the architectural decisions and code-sharing strategies needed to create maintainable experiences across web, mobile, and desktop environments. Attendees will leave with practical guidance for deciding what to share, what to abstract, and what to implement separately when extending a Blazor web application to mobile and desktop with .NET MAUI Hybrid.

拥有现有 Blazor 网页应用的团队通常被要求在移动和桌面平台上提供相同功能，而无需从头重建应用。在本节课中，我将演示 Razor 组件、服务、UI 模式和业务逻辑如何在 Blazor 网络应用与面向 Android、iOS、Windows 和 macOS 的 .NET MAUI Blazor 混合应用之间共享。

现场演示将展示同一应用在网页上运行，同时作为原生混合应用运行，包含共享组件，如数据网格和图表。我将解释哪些内容可以直接重用，哪些需要平台特定适应，以及如何利用Razor类库和BlazorWebView构建共享代码。

会议还将探讨在网页、移动和桌面环境中创建可维护体验所需的架构决策和代码共享策略。与会者将获得实用指导，帮助他们决定在通过.NET MAUI Hybrid将Blazor网页应用扩展到移动端和桌面端时，分享什么、抽象哪些以及分别实现什么。

Bethuya 是一个由 Blazor、.NET MAUI、Aspire 和 Azure AI Foundry 构建的 AI 驱动社区平台。它受到现实开发者社区运营挑战的启发，推出了统一参与账本，不仅仅关注出席，还涵盖志愿服务、指导、演讲、组织和学习活动。

在本节中，我们将探讨现代.NET协议栈如何实现跨网页、移动、分布式服务和AI驱动体验的单一平台。我们将涵盖架构决策、Aspire的服务编排、MAUI的跨平台体验、Blazor的角色感知接口，以及由Azure AI Foundry驱动的AI驱动功能。

与会者将获得关于如何构建云原生、基于 .NET 的 AI 驱动应用的实用指导，以及构建生产社区平台的经验教训。 

GitHub仓库：https://github.com/HackerspaceMumbai/bethuya

Title: Let’s catch up with C#!
Speaker: Filip Ekberg
Description:
With every iteration of C#, we get more and more features that are meant to make our lives as developer a lot easier.

Let's explore some of the most interesting features in C# 9, 10, 11, 12, 13 and 14!

We will look at how the language has changed and why these changes to the language will make us better C# developers, with less bugs in our code.

We will cover features such as:
- Nullable reference types
- Pattern Matching in C# 8 => C# 14
- Record types
- Primary constructors
- Collection expressions
- Extension members

If you're working with C#, this is a session you do not want to miss!
DescriptionInZh:
随着C#的每一次迭代，我们都获得了越来越多的功能，旨在让我们作为开发者的工作更加轻松。

让我们一起探索C# 9、10、11、12、13和14中一些最有趣的功能！

我们将探讨语言的变化，以及为什么这些变化能让我们成为更好的 C# 开发者，代码中的错误更少。

我们将介绍以下功能：
- 可空引用类型
- C# 8 => C# 14 模式匹配
- 记录类型
- 主要制造商
- 集合表达式
- 扩展成员

如果你正在使用C#，这绝对是你不想错过的一次会议！

Title: Eliminating Hidden Dangers to Your Applications: Patterns for Reliable Systems
Speaker: Barry Stahl
Description:
There is a danger lurking in every system that hasn't taken explicit steps to eliminate it. This under-recognized data killer can cause inconsistencies in your system which can be as difficult to find as they are to correct. Fortunately, recognizing this monster is easy, and there are a number of great techniques you can use to keep it away for good.

In this talk, we will learn about the Dual-Writes anti-pattern: how to spot it, and what to do to avoid it. In doing so, we'll discuss several well-known patterns that when implemented in your microservices architecture, can help prevent the difficult errors often caused by dual-writes so you can spend more time at awesome conferences and less time supporting your applications. We'll review a number of examples in C#, including demonstrations using SQL Server, Cosmos DB and Kafka.
DescriptionInZh:
每个没有明确消除它的系统都潜藏着危险。这种被低估的数据杀手会导致系统出现不一致，既难以发现，也难以纠正。幸运的是，识别这个怪物很容易，且有许多绝佳技巧可以彻底阻止它。

在本次演讲中，我们将了解双写反模式：如何识别它以及如何避免它。在此过程中，我们将讨论几个已知的模式，这些模式在你的微服务架构中实现后，可以帮助预防双写带来的复杂错误，从而让你能花更多时间参加精彩的会议，减少支持应用的时间。我们将回顾多个C#示例，包括使用 SQL Server、Cosmos DB 和 Kafka 的演示。

Title: Building Dual-Screen Experiences with Avalonia
Speaker: Javier Suárez
Description:
Dual-screen and foldable devices introduce more than just extra space. Applications need to adapt their layout while preserving state, focus and the user’s context as the available screen configuration changes.

In this session, we’ll explore how to build dual-screen experiences with Avalonia using TwoPaneView and the framework’s capabilities. Through several practical samples, we’ll look at common patterns such as list-detail interfaces, navigation experiences, editors and content that can move naturally between one and two panes.
We’ll demonstrate how these interfaces behave across different form factors, including iPhone Duo and other Android devices, and see how the same UI can adapt when running on a conventional desktop or single-screen device.
Along the way, we’ll cover pane placement, spanning and folding scenarios, responsive layouts, state preservation or manage the focus state.

You’ll leave with practical patterns and reusable techniques for building Avalonia applications that work naturally on both single-screen and dual-screen devices.
DescriptionInZh:
双屏和可折叠设备带来的不仅仅是额外空间。应用程序需要调整布局，同时保持状态、焦点和用户上下文，以应对屏幕配置的变化。

在本节课中，我们将探讨如何利用TwoPaneView及其框架功能构建Avalonia的双屏体验。通过多个实用示例，我们将探讨常见模式，如列表细节界面、导航体验、编辑器以及能够在一窗格和两个窗格间自然移动的内容。
我们将演示这些界面在不同形态上的表现，包括 iPhone Duo 和其他安卓设备，并观察同一界面在传统桌面或单屏设备上运行时如何适应。
在此过程中，我们将涵盖窗格布局、跨度与折叠场景、响应式布局、状态保持或焦点状态管理。

你将获得实用的模式和可重复使用的Avalonia应用，这些应用能在单屏和双屏设备上自然运行。

Title: Shipping a VS Code extension backed by a .NET Tool based analyzer
Speaker: Erik Ejlskov Jensen
Description:
VS Code speaks TypeScript, but my T-SQL analysis rules are C# on top of DacFx. So how do you light up 140+ .NET analyzer rules as the developer types — no build step, nothing to manually install?

In this talk I'll show how I built the T-SQL Analyzer VS Code extension as a thin TypeScript front-end (with no previous TypeScript experience) over a long-lived .NET back-end: a persistent analyzer process, a simple stdin/stdout JSON protocol, and distribution as a NuGet tool run via dnx (so users just need the .NET 11 SDK).

I'll share the real lessons learned — so you can put a friendly editor experience on top of any .NET library you already own.
Takeaways
•	Architect an editor extension as a thin UI over a reusable .NET engine
•	Design a minimal, robust stdin/stdout JSON protocol
•	Run and supervise a long-lived .NET server (spawn, crash recovery, shutdown)
•	Distribute via NuGet + dnx for zero-install users
•	Turn analysis results into live diagnostics with good error UX
DescriptionInZh:
VS Code 支持 TypeScript，但我的 T-SQL 分析规则是 C# 加在 DacFx 之上。那么，当开发者输入时，如何点亮 140+ .NET 分析规则——没有构建步骤，也不需要手动安装？

在这场演讲中，我将展示我如何将 T-SQL Analyzer VS Code 扩展作为一个薄的 TypeScript 前端（之前没有 TypeScript 经验）构建在一个长期使用的 .NET 后端之上：一个持久分析进程、一个简单的 stdin/stdout JSON 协议，以及通过 dnx 运行的 NuGet 工具分发版（用户只需 .NET 11 SDK）。

我会分享真正的经验教训——这样你就能在已有的任何 .NET 库之上，为你带来友好的编辑器体验。
要点
• 将编辑器扩展设计为可重用的 .NET 引擎上的薄界面
• 设计一个简约、稳健的标准/标准输出 JSON 协议
• 运行和监督一个长寿命的.NET服务器（生成、崩溃恢复、关闭）
• 通过NuGet + dnx分发给零安装用户
• 将分析结果转化为实时诊断，并提供良好的错误用户体验

Title: When Unit tests are not enough: Property-based testing and Snapshot tests
Speaker: Davide Bellone
Description:
Unit Tests are all fun and games until they aren’t enough.

Integration Tests are better in many scenarios, but they aren’t always the best choice either.

What other kinds of tests do we have up our sleeves?

We can use Snapshot Tests to verify that we haven’t introduced regressions, and Property-based Tests to verify that invariants always hold.

Attendees will leave with a practical way to decide when to use example-based tests (such as Unit and Integration tests), Property-based Tests, Snapshots Tests, or a combination of all three, using xUnit, FsCheck, and Verify.
DescriptionInZh:
单元测试都是玩乐，直到觉得不够。

积分测试在很多情况下更好，但也不总是最佳选择。

我们还有什么其他测试方法？

我们可以用快照测试来验证没有引入回归，也可以用基于性质的测试来验证不变量始终成立。

与会者将获得一个实用的方法，决定何时使用基于示例的测试（如单元测试和集成测试）、基于属性的测试、快照测试，或三者结合，使用xUnit、FsCheck和Verify。

Title: ASP.NET Core 11 💖 OpenTelemetry
Speaker: Martin Costello
Description:
ASP.NET Core 11 includes built-in support for OpenTelemetry metrics and traces which follow the OpenTelemetry Semantic Conventions for HTTP Servers.

But what are Semantic Conventions?

In this session we'll go into what the OpenTelemetry Semantic Conventions are and where ASP.NET Core 11 implements them.

Then we'll show how you can leverage them to validate your telemetry and generate consistent dashboards and alerts for polyglot services across your environment, no matter what programming languages they're written in.
DescriptionInZh:
ASP.NET Core 11 内置支持 OpenTelemetry 的度量和跟踪，这些都遵循 HTTP 服务器的 OpenTelemetry 语义规范。

那么，什么是语义约定？

在本节会议中，我们将探讨什么是 OpenTelemetry 语义规范，以及 Core 11 在哪 ASP.NET 实现了它们。

然后我们将展示如何利用它们验证遥测数据，生成一致的仪表盘和警报，适用于环境中的多语言服务，无论它们用什么编程语言编写。

Title: Why not both? Bringing Modern Web Development to .NET
Speaker: David Whitney
Description:
This talk is about the process of building three "what if" experiments that turned into a real projects to bring popular libraries, languages and tools to the .NET ecosystem.

- JsxCore - Native .NET bindings for ASP.NET MVC and React and JSX.
- AstroSharp - C# support for the popular Astro Static site builder
- TsxCore - a TypeScript compiler that targets MSIL and the CLR that compiles Typescript programs to native .NET

We'll cover how these seemingly impossible projects work, how they were designed, and why picking the best tool for the job sometimes takes you to really weird places.

A fun deep dive where you'll learn how to bridge seemingly incompatible platforms, build framework-like tools, and hopefully inspire you to make things you like play together. A talk about having your cake, and eating it.
DescriptionInZh:
本次演讲讲述了构建三个“如果”实验的过程，这些实验最终演变成了一个真正的项目，将流行的库、语言和工具引入.NET生态系统。

- JsxCore - 原生 .NET 绑定，支持 ASP.NET MVC、React 和 JSX。
- AstroSharp - 对流行的Astro Static网站建设器的C#支持。
- TsxCore - 一个针对MSIL和将Typescript程序编译为原生.NET 的CLR编译器

我们将介绍这些看似不可能完成的项目是如何运作的，它们是如何设计的，以及为什么选择最适合这项工作的工具有时会带你进入非常奇怪的境地。

一个有趣的深度探索，你将学会如何搭建看似不兼容的平台，构建类似框架的工具，并希望激励你让喜欢的东西一起玩起来。关于“蛋糕与蛋糕兼得”的谈话。

Title: SE.Redis in .NET 11
Speaker: Marc Gravell
Description:
Redis is a foundational piece of tech in many applications, and SE.Redis is the primary library for talking to Redis from .NET, either directly or via tools like asp.net caching, Hybrid Cache, Fusion Cache, etc.

Here we:

- have a quick look at new exciting features in SE.Redis like client-side-caching, active-active, etc for richer applications
- look at how SE.Redis 4.0 uses new C#/.NET features to create a new hyper-efficient API, while trivially supporting the pre-existing API
DescriptionInZh:
Redis 是许多应用和软件工程中的基础技术。Redis 是通过 .NET 与 Redis 通信的主要库，无论是直接访问还是通过 asp.net 缓存、混合缓存、融合缓存等工具。

我们：

- 快速浏览软件工程中令人兴奋的新特性。Redis 如客户端缓存、主动缓存等，适合更丰富的应用
- 看看 SE 如何。Redis 4.0 利用新的 C#/.NET 特性创建了一个高效的新 API，同时轻松支持已有的 API

Title: Beyond Prototypes: Building Production Ready AI Workflows
Speaker: Cecil Phillip
Description:
Building a quick AI prototype in .NET is easier than ever, but architecting an AI-driven backend that can handle production workloads is a different story. Long-running prompts, rate-limited external APIs, and complex state management quickly turn simple intelligent apps into distributed systems challenges.

This session explores the idea of durable AI for modern systems. We'll look at building robust backends in C# that leverage libraries like Microsoft.Extensions.AI alongside Temporal's open source durable execution engine to orchestrate intelligent tasks reliably. We'll walk through code examples showing how to encapsulate LLM calls into resilient, stateful workflows that survive crashes, network issues, and API throttling, giving you a clear blueprint for production-ready AI.
DescriptionInZh:
在.NET中构建快速AI原型比以往任何时候都容易，但构建一个能够处理生产工作负载的AI驱动后端则是另一回事。长期运行的提示符、受限速率的外部API和复杂的状态管理，迅速将简单的智能应用变成分布式系统的挑战。

本节探讨了现代系统中持久人工智能的理念。我们将探讨如何构建C#的强大后端，利用 Microsoft.Extensions.AI 等库以及Temporal的开源持久执行引擎，可靠地协调智能任务。我们将带您演示代码示例，展示如何将LLM调用封装成能够抵御崩溃、网络问题和API限流的有弹性、有状态的工作流，为你提供生产准备AI的清晰蓝图。

Title: Meeple-Driven Design: Modeling Board Game Domains with C# 15 & .NET 11
Speaker: Sarah Dutkiewicz
Description:
How do you model a game turn when a player can either roll dice, play a card, or pass without relying on vague string flags, null-heavy wrapper classes, or unsafe casting?

In this fast-paced 30-minute session, we’ll take a trip to the tabletop. We will use real-world board game mechanics - such as player turns, tile placement validations, and victory conditions - to explore the newest domain modeling capabilities in C# 15 and .NET 11.

You'll learn how native Discriminated Unions replace custom result wrappers, how Closed Hierarchies force exhaustive compile-time checking across game actions, how System.Text.Json handles complex union state out of the box, and how EF Core 11 indexes deeply nested complex types without schema friction. Walk away with cleaner, safer C# patterns you can apply directly to your software - no board game experience required!
DescriptionInZh:
当玩家可以掷骰子、出牌或放弃，而不依赖模糊的字符串旗帜、重空包装职业或不安全的施法时，如何模拟游戏回合？

在这场节奏紧凑的30分钟环节中，我们将带你走进桌面游戏。我们将运用现实世界的桌游机制——如玩家回合、瓦片放置验证和胜利条件——探索C# 15和.NET 11中最新的域名建模能力。

你将学习原生的Discriminated Union如何取代自定义结果封装器，Closed Hierarchies如何强制游戏动作间的详尽编译检查，System.Text.Json如何开箱即用地处理复杂的合并状态，以及EF Core 11如何无模式摩擦地索引深度嵌套的复杂类型。你可以直接将C#模式应用到软件中，获得更干净、更安全的模式——无需桌游经验！

Title: Introducing BlazorKit
Speaker: Shaun Walker
Description: BlazorKit is a new open source project template for .NET 11 that allows you to  build, extend, and deploy modern .NET web applications with the power of Blazor... but without the complexity of assembling everything from scratch. Utilizing an advanced template like BlazorKit dramatically reduces the amount of infrastructure developers need to create and maintain themselves. Rather than asking every project team to solve the same problems repeatedly, organizations can start with a proven foundation which enables them to spend more time building differentiated business functionality and less time creating application plumbing.
DescriptionInZh: BlazorKit 是一个全新的开源项目模板，适用于 .NET 11，允许你利用 Blazor 的强大功能构建、扩展和部署现代 .NET Web 应用......但无需从零组装所有内容的复杂性。使用像 BlazorKit 这样高级模板，大大减少了开发者创建和维护基础设施所需的数量。组织可以从经过验证的基础开始，从而花更多时间构建差异化的业务功能，减少繁琐的应用流程。

Title: Infrastructure as (Actual) Code with C# 15 and .NET 11
Speaker: Cam Soper
Description:
Infrastructure as code usually means infrastructure as YAML, or a DSL that's almost a programming language. But if you already know C#, you already know how to build cloud infrastructure.

This session introduces infrastructure as code in plain C# using Pulumi's open source .NET SDK. We'll build and deploy real Azure infrastructure with the tools you already use every day, then put C# 15 and .NET 11 to work so the compiler catches infrastructure mistakes before they ever reach the cloud.

That matters more than ever now that AI agents are writing infrastructure code too. A rule written in an agent's instructions is a suggestion. A rule written in the type system is enforced, no matter who (or what) wrote the change.
DescriptionInZh:
基础设施作为代码通常指的是像YAML这样的基础设施，或者类似编程语言的DSL。但如果你已经懂C#，你也知道如何构建云基础设施。

本场介绍基础设施以代码形式使用Pulumi的开源.NET SDK的纯C#代码。我们将用你每天使用的工具构建并部署真正的Azure基础设施，然后运用C# 15和.NET 11，使编译器能在基础设施错误到达云端之前捕捉它们。

现在AI代理也在编写基础设施代码，这一点比以往任何时候都更重要。代理指令中写的规则是一种建议。用类型系统编写的规则会被强制执行，无论是谁（或什么）写的。

Title: IaC Forged in Code: Building Resilient Infrastructure with Modules
Speaker: Mike Benkovich
Description: How do you build a Shared Cloud Infrastructure that fits your needs and grows as your needs grow? In this session we look at Infrastructure as Code tools like Bicep and Terraform and explore how to design and implement a shared infrastructure pattern that is resilient, reusable, and maintainable. We'll cover module authoring, versioning, and distribution, as well as how to enforce naming conventions, tagging standards, and organizational policies through modules. Whether you're new to IaC or looking to improve your existing workflows, this session provides practical guidance for building a shared cloud infrastructure that works for your organization.
DescriptionInZh: 如何构建一个符合你需求的共享云基础设施，并随着需求增长而不断增长？在本节中，我们将探讨基础设施即代码工具如Bicep和Terraform，并探讨如何设计和实施一个具有弹性、可重用和可维护的共享基础设施模式。我们将涵盖模块创作、版本管理和分发，以及如何通过模块强制命名规范、标签标准和组织政策。无论你是IaC新手，还是希望改进现有工作流程，本课程都为构建适合你组织的共享云基础设施提供了实用指导。

Title: Rethinking Microservices with Orleans
Speaker: Ryan Karg
Description:
What if how you structure an application didn't have to dictate how you deploy it?

Traditional microservice architectures often treat architectural separation and physical distribution as the same problem. Orleans takes a different approach, allowing applications to be implemented as loosely coupled components while keeping deployment topology flexible.

In this session, we'll draw on our experience building game backends and other services with Orleans to explore how systems can evolve from a single process to multi-cluster and multi-region deployments without changing the underlying programming model. We'll discuss the realities of latency in globally distributed systems and along the way examine how Orleans can reduce communication costs, simplify operations, and challenge common assumptions about microservice design.
DescriptionInZh:
如果你构建一个应用程序的方式不必决定你如何部署它，会怎样？

传统微服务架构通常将架构分离和物理分布视为同一问题。Orleans 采取了不同的方法，允许应用作为松耦合组件实现，同时保持部署拓扑的灵活性。

在本节课中，我们将结合与Orleans构建游戏后端及其他服务的经验，探讨系统如何从单一进程演进到多集群和多区域部署，而无需改变底层编程模型。我们将讨论全球分布系统中延迟的现实，并探讨Orleans如何降低通信成本、简化运营，并挑战关于微服务设计的常见假设。

Title: Building Oracle AI Apps with .NET and EF Core 11
Speaker: Alex Keh
Description: .NET 11 and Oracle AI Database 26ai introduce new features for AI development. We’ll explore EF Core 11 support for VECTOR_SEARCH(), vector indexes, and more. Discover how seamlessly the new Oracle AI Database Vector Store Connector integrates with native .NET vectors and Microsoft Agent Framework. Watch how Oracle Deep Data Security helps provide least-privilege access for agentic AI from .NET applications without any app code changes. See all these capabilities in action through demos.
DescriptionInZh: .NET 11 和 Oracle AI Database 26ai 引入了 AI 开发新功能。我们将探讨 EF Core 11 对 VECTOR_SEARCH（）、向量索引等的支持。了解全新的 Oracle AI 数据库向量存储连接器如何无缝集成原生 .NET 向量和 Microsoft 代理框架。观看 Oracle 深度数据安全如何帮助 .NET 应用为代理型 AI 提供最低权限访问，无需更改应用代码。通过演示观看所有这些功能的实际应用。

Title: All in one E2E testing of ASP.NET Core web apps with UI/security/accessibility tests and more
Speaker: Zoltán Lehóczky
Description: Do you have an ASP.NET Core web app and make sure that it works? You can use the open-source UI Testing Toolbox to do all that: with the power of Selenium for browser UI tests, axe for checking accessibility, Zed Attack Proxy for security scans, and many more tools built in, it's a complete package. See all of this in action with plenty of (C#) code!
DescriptionInZh: 你有 ASP.NET Core 的网页应用并确保它能正常工作吗？你可以使用开源的 UI 测试工具箱来完成所有这些：借助 Selenium 的浏览器界面测试、axe 的无障碍检查、Zed Attack Proxy 的安全扫描以及许多内置工具，这是一个完整的软件包。用大量的（C#）代码来体验这一切的实际应用！
